title: Multiplicities of graded families of ideals on Noetherian local rings
summary: Let $R$ be a $d$-dimensional Noetherian local ring with maximal ideal $m_R$. In this article, we give a generalization of the multiplicity $e(I)$ of an $m_R$-primary ideal $I$ of $R$ to a multiplicity $e(\mathcal I)$ of a graded family of $m_R$-primary ideals $\mathcal I$ in $R$. This multiplicity gives the classical multiplicity $e(I)$ if $\mathcal I=\{I^n\}$ is the $I$-adic filtration, and agrees with the volume, $\displaystyle \lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}d!\frac{\ell(R/I_n) }{n^d}$ for $R$ such that the volume always exists as a limit.
